parsed.explanation: Score 0.25 (High Risk). The national penal code criminalises same-sex conduct (up to 20 years plus whipping) and includes an undefined gross-indecency offence; Sharia cross-dressing laws apply to Muslim visitors, and religious enforcement has been officially licensed against trans people. Recent raids on queer venues—including a 2025 sauna raid with 31 foreign nationals—show the sodomy law is used as a lever, not a dead letter. Detention risks include male-ward sexual violence and extortion. Mitigations: no explicit trans visa rule, tourists rarely targeted, enforcement is episodic, and some Sharia provisions were struck down without decriminalisation. The 2019 trans killings are dated and no violence rate is given. State-sanctioned exposure and custodial risk keep this in the High Risk band, not Severe.
